ollama._options_comment: Optional Ollama generation options passed to /api/chat. Defaults to {"temperature": 0} for reliable tool calling. Override e.g. {"temperature": 0.2, "num_ctx": 8192}.

mcp_server._comment: crystaldba/postgres-mcp exposes execute_sql, so writes are possible and OUR guard gates them. Needs `uv` installed (https://docs.astral.sh/uv). For a read-only demo without uv, use the npx block below instead.

_mcp_servers_comment: To connect several MCP servers at once, use `mcp_servers` (an array) instead of `mcp_server`. Each entry may set a `name` used to namespace tools when names collide (exposed as `<name>__<tool>`), and a `dialect` ("postgres" | "clickhouse") so the guard classifies that server's SQL correctly and backend-tagged specs route to it. Copy the block below to enable the Postgres + ClickHouse copilot.
_specs_dir_comment: Folder of *.spec.md semantic-layer / verified-query files. Loaded into the prompt as grounding and checked by `pg-mcp-agent verify`.
_audit_log_comment: Optional JSONL audit log: one record per tool call (tool, args, guard decision, status). Omit to disable.
_verify_answers_comment: Warn when a figure in the model's answer isn't found among the aggregates computable from the last result set (catches hallucinated numbers). Default true.
_cdc_comment: Optional Postgres→ClickHouse CDC plan. `cdc plan` prints the direct MaterializedPostgreSQL setup DDL; `cdc plan --via kafka` prints the Debezium→Kafka→ClickHouse fan-out (needs the `fanout` block below); `cdc inspect` checks wal_level + replication slots, plus Kafka consumers when `fanout` is set. The password is read from `source.password_env` at generate time and never stored; if unset a {PASSWORD} placeholder is emitted. Empty `tables` means all tables. See docs/cdc-fanout.md.
